title: Draw Call Benchmark Chart
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Analyze draw-time benchmarking data comparing full-primitive redraws against blitted-sprite redraws for a complete face frame, to differentiate which technique costs more microseconds per frame and examine why.

learningObjectives: Analyze draw-time benchmarking data comparing full-primitive redraws against blitted-sprite redraws for a complete face frame, to differentiate which technique costs more microseconds per frame and examine why.
